d: The Oklahoma City Thunder opened the season with a 116-104 victory over the San Antonio Spurs. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led Oklahoma City with 32 points, five rebounds, and four assists, extending his streak to 141 straight games with 20 or more points, while Jared McCain added 20 points on 7-of-9 shooting, including six three-pointers. Chet Holmgren contributed 14 points, seven rebounds, two assists, and four blocks.
